programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: This coming-of-age film follows the mayhem of a group of rowdy teenagers in Austin, Texas, celebrating the last day of high school in 1976. The graduating class heads for a popular pool hall and joins an impromptu keg party, however star football player Randall Pink Floyd has promised to focus on the championship game and abstain from partying. Meanwhile, the incoming freshmen try to avoid being hazed by the seniors, most notably the sadistic bully Fred O'Bannion.

programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: To Be Killed by A High School Girl [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Min-Jae is broke and needs to pay for his mother's operation. He decides to get his apartment deposit money back, but a bully takes his money. The bully gives his money to loan shark Baek who gives the money to politician Moon. Baek is not happy that he has to continually give money to the politician and decides to kill him. Baek hires a killer to take out Moon. Baek is in possession of a gun that Detective Choi gave up as a pledge at a gambling hall. Baek has the detective's gun delivered to the killer, but the delivery man mistakenly gives the gun to Min-Jae.

programme.title: Judgment With Ashleigh Banfield
programme.sub-title: Judgment Of Dalia Dippolito With Ashleigh Banfield
programme.desc: In 2013, the small city of Weatherford, Texas was rocked by the brutal slaying of local son, JD Doss. The murder weapon? A pickaxe. The murderer? His close friend, 24-year-old Nicholas Camfield. In a shocking twist, Camfield not only killed his victim by repeatedly striking him in the head, he also mutilated, scalped, and defiled his body over the course of days. In one of David Scott's most shocking interviews, Camfield gives a glimpse inside his deranged, murderous mind.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. programme.title: Equal Playing Field
programme.desc: Join us on a once-in-a-lifetime adventure as 30 female soccer players from 24 different countries summit Mount Kilimanjaro and descend into the Dead Sea, to play the highest and lowest elevation soccer matches ever played. With their powerful backstories woven in, we watch as these courageous women band together to play the most challenging games of their lives. Striving to spread awareness for gender equality, these women fight to set a new Guinness World Record.

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: The Dordogne consists of a visible and an invisible system of flowing water. Caves and basins under the earth's surface store the excess water and return it to the river when it is dry. A perfect management of a precious resource, not invented by humans, but by the complex nature itself. The result is an ever life-giving river.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends
programme.desc: Laugh & Learn is a charming educational show designed for preschoolers, where entertainment meets learning. Featuring adorable characters, the show introduces children to fundamental concepts such as numbers, letters, shapes, and colors through interactive play, memorable songs, and engaging storylines. programme.title: Bernard
programme.desc: Boom & Reds, una serie preescolar. Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.title: To Be Killed by A High School Girl [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Min-Jae is broke and needs to pay for his mother's operation. He decides to get his apartment deposit money back, but a bully takes his money. The bully gives his money to loan shark Baek who gives the money to politician Moon. Baek is not happy that he has to continually give money to the politician and decides to kill him. Baek hires a killer to take out Moon. Baek is in possession of a gun that Detective Choi gave up as a pledge at a gambling hall. Baek has the detective's gun delivered to the killer, but the delivery man mistakenly gives the gun to Min-Jae.
